admin.title: Using the site as an administrator
admin.intro: Open everything from the left sidebar. Use the sequence below the first time you work through the panel.
steps: Click "Overview" to see platform totals, charts and analytics.

Click "Owners". New self-registrations appear inactive: use the ON/OFF switch in each row so the person can sign in, or turn it off to block them. When you block an owner, their managers are blocked too.
Use the All / Active / Inactive filters above the table to find people faster.
Click "Hotels" to create a hotel or edit its name, address and description.
Open the bell (top right) for notifications; tap a row to mark it read, or use "Mark all read".
quick: Use language and theme switches in the header next to the bell.
If a new owner cannot log in, check Owners — they must be active first.
The bell can play a short sound when something new arrives.

owner.title: Using the site as a hotel owner
owner.intro: Your menu only lists your portfolio. Typical setup order is: hotels → rooms → customers → bookings.
steps: Click "Dashboard" for occupancy, revenue and trends for your hotels.
Click "My Hotels" to add each property or edit its details.
Click "Rooms" and add or edit rooms: type, AMD price per night, capacity; make sure they belong to the right hotel.
Click "Customers" and create profiles for guests you will book often.
Click "Bookings", then "New": choose room and customer, set check-in and check-out (defaults 14:00 and 12:00). The total amount is calculated automatically.
Use the bell for real-time alerts about bookings and account changes.
quick: Dates and times use 24-hour format everywhere.
Amounts are shown in AMD without decimals in lists.
Charts and tables respect dark mode and your language.

manager.title: Using the site as a manager
manager.intro: You operate one assigned hotel. Use the sidebar for Today, Rooms, Customers and Bookings.
steps: Click "Today" to see today’s check-ins, check-outs and occupancy.
Click "Customers" to add guest profiles or edit people linked to your hotel (including walk-ins you register here).
Click "Bookings". Use the green action when the guest arrives, purple when they leave, red to cancel — the room status updates by itself.
Open "Rooms" to check availability (this screen may be read-only for some fields).
To delete a reservation you must ask an owner or administrator — managers cannot delete bookings here.
Use the bell so you do not miss booking or hotel updates.
quick: You can edit dates and notes on a booking if your role allows that action.
If the owner account is turned off, your login will stop working on the next request.
Mark notification lines as read so the badge count stays accurate.
